claim: To change the instance type of an instance with an instance store root volume, you migrate to a new instance type; changing the type in place is not applicable.
question: How do you change the instance type of an instance store-backed instance?

values.spoken: an in-place change does not apply

values.display: Migrate to a new instance type
values.spoken: you migrate to a new instance

qualifiers.scope: an instance with an instance store root volume
